description: Abstract class for JavaScript invocation services in the Thingsboard platform, managing script evaluation, invocation, validation, and resource limits.

classes.name: AbstractJsInvokeService
classes.description: Abstract class providing core functionality for JavaScript invocation, script management, and resource limits within the platform.

methods.name: isScriptPresent
methods.description: Checks if a script with the given UUID exists in the script info map.

methods.name: isExecEnabled
methods.description: Determines if JavaScript execution is enabled for a given tenant.

methods.name: reportExecution
methods.description: Reports a script execution event for usage tracking.

methods.name: doInvokeFunction
methods.description: Executes a script function with provided arguments, returning a task.

methods.name: doEvalScript
methods.description: Evaluates a script by hashing its body, generating a function, and preparing it for execution.

methods.name: doRelease
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a script ID.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the script body for correctness and compliance.

methods.name: generateJsScript
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code based on script type and provided script body and arguments.

methods.name: constructFunctionName
methods.description: Constructs a unique function name based on script ID.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Creates a hash of the script body and tenant ID for identification.

methods.name: getStatsType
methods.description: Returns the statistics type for this service.
